restrictions: Emergency/normal-communication use is subject to the official-authority/cooperation condition.
The band may also be used for amateur and amateur-satellite communication.
F3E and G3E emissions shall not be used between 28000 and 29500 kHz.
For training/promotion, B-class amateurs may use a self-built transmitter not exceeding 5 W; the source text writes the range as 28000-29700 MHz despite the row itself being in kHz/HF.
Beacon transmitters in 28-28.500 MHz are limited to 25 W.

rows.notes: The source emission cell visibly repeats F2B and J3F, and lists A3J and J2C. Tablo 26-1 defines neither A3J nor J2C. The machine list de-duplicates repeated tokens but does not silently replace undefined codes. See TR-BTK-EMISSION-001.

restrictions: Earth-Moon-Earth communication is allowed by the table text.
Beacon transmitters in 50-52 MHz are limited to 25 W.
